title: Night Train Letters
description: Three unsent letters, a rain-soaked night train and a journey to the sea. Follow a quiet branching story of estranged sisters, a blue bicycle and the courage to be forgiven.
controls: Click / tap choices, or press 1–2. Click the passage or press Space to reveal it; Space again takes the first choice. Tab / Enter for buttons. P / Escape to pause. R to restart.

zh-CN.title: 夜行列车的信
zh-CN.description: 三封没寄出的信、一列雨夜列车、一段去海边的旅程。一个关于疏远的姐妹、一辆蓝色自行车和被原谅的勇气的分支故事。
zh-CN.controls: 点击选项或按 1–2 · 点击段落或按空格显示全文，再按空格选第一项 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
